investigator.method: Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC only: retained evidence acquired via curl (raw HTTP, no WebFetch/AI-markdown conversion) with a descriptive User-Agent, no authentication, no browser. A plain curl GET of the venue's own official contact page established its exact evidenced address; a plain curl GET of the Fourvenues platform's own public, unauthenticated events endpoint (linked from the venue's own ticketing flow) for this organizer_slug returned 200 OK with well-formed JSON. The platform's own default window returned far fewer records than an explicit forward-only [now, now+2y] window — this package's own collector always passes an explicit window to reach the genuine future horizon deterministically.
